decision.observation: 3 mph, gear 1, all dots dark, red X lit. The car is on the lane heading up-screen with a large blue puddle right at its front-right corner and a bale stack on the lower-left verge; the tarmac continues up and bends right past more puddles.
decision.hypothesis: The puddle at the nose is the likely stall point again; the car is centred on the lane, so uninterrupted throttle should push it through rather than steering into either verge.
decision.memory: The bale stacks can reappear at lower-left whenever the camera swings, so displacement is judged from lane curvature and puddle layout, not the bales alone. Plain W remains the stall breaker.
